title: steps/<ordinal>-<id>/failure.yaml (L1)
description: The structured explanation of why one step did not pass, at tests/<id>/steps/<ordinal>-<id>/failure.yaml — authored by the framework (or a triage agent). Required core: `step` (anchored to the folder and a result.yaml step), `status` (verdict enum), and evidence-of-what (error.message, or expected+actual). File references resolve relative to the TEST ROOT tests/<id>/ (no '..', no leading '/', no scheme) and are checked for containment and existence by the validator, never parsed — the schema only requires them to be strings. The optional `triage` block is strictly shaped when present; free-form forensic blocks stay open. See decision 0044.

step.description: The step id. MUST equal the containing folder's <id> and match a result.yaml step — a validator cross-check (l1.failure.unmatched).

status.description: The step verdict — same vocabulary as result.yaml (decision 0006). Cross-checked against the matched step; disagreement is an advisory warning (l1.failure.status_disagrees).

title.description: Short defect-style name for the failure, authored by the framework (typically the investigation verdict's bug title). Optional; open string, never cross-checked.

error.description: The error at failure. `type` is an open string; `urls` are external locations (open, never checked).

repro.description: How to reproduce. `definition`/`resolved` are test-root-relative file references (validator-checked).

locator_context.description: Open block — selector forensics in the framework's own vocabulary.

page_state.description: Page state at failure. `url` is an external URL (open); `dom`/`a11y`/`screenshot` are test-root-relative file references (validator-checked).

console_at_failure.description: `ref` is a test-root-relative file reference (validator-checked); the rest is open.

network_at_failure.description: `ref` is a test-root-relative file reference (validator-checked); the rest is open.

triage.description: Optional post-hoc triage. Strictly shaped when present (decision 0044): closed lifecycle enums, required sub-fields, bounded confidence.

by.description: Who/what triaged. `kind` and `id` are open strings; `at` is required when the block is present.

rca.description: Root-cause analysis. `root_cause` is required; `category` is an open string; `evidence` entries are test-root-relative file references (validator-checked).

suggested_fix.description: `patch` is a test-root-relative file reference (validator-checked); `summary`/`target` are open.

verification.description: Whether the suggested fix was checked: not yet, confirmed to resolve, or checked and did NOT resolve.
